newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Growth Properties sets A$180 mln IPO.
newsitem.headline: Australian Growth Properties sets A$180 mln IPO.

text.p: Australian Growth Properties Ltd (AGP), which holds the Australian property assets of New Zealand property group, Trans Tasman Properties Ltd, on Tuesday launched a public share offer to raise A$180 million.
The offer of 180 million A$1 shares was made to retail and institutional investors to acquire 59 percent of AGP from Trans Tasman which would retain a 41 percent stake in the
AGP said the proceeds of the float would be used principally to retire existing debt and facilitate future investments and developments in Australia.

The company said future developments included a office block in Sydney which was approved by the Sydney City Council in December last year and was expected to be worth more than A$300 million by completion in late 1999.
